author: LadyofHats (Mariana Ruiz)
description:
This is a diagram of an animal cell. I based my information on these diagrams:
http://www.bartleby.com/images/A4images/A4cell.jpg[ dead link ]
http://www.dmacc.cc.ia.us/instructors/tmbergin/animalcell.jpg[dead link]
http://www.npc.edu/Bio105/media/m1_l6-01.gif[ dead link ]
http://www.csus.edu/indiv/l/loom/animal%20cell.jpg[ dead link ]
http://www.rkm.com.au/CELL/cellimages/cellannot700.jpg].
There are some structures I did not add because it was not clear to me how they should look. For all have doubts between cytoskeleton, microfibers and microtubules. If you would like to make another language version of it, message me and I can make an image without text for you or message me the names in the language you want them to appear.
credit: Own work using Adobe Illustrator. Image renamed from File:Animal cell structure.svg
